# Image to Base64

Image to Base64 is a free browser-based utility for converting image files to Base64 and Base64 image data back into downloadable image files. Conversion happens locally in the browser; image data is not uploaded to a conversion server.

## Main tool

- [Image to Base64 converter](https://base64img.pages.dev/#panel-to-base64): Select, drop, or paste an image and copy a Data URI, raw Base64, HTML `<img>` markup, or CSS background-image value. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG, BMP, ICO, and AVIF files up to 20 MB.
- [Base64 to Image converter](https://base64img.pages.dev/#panel-to-image): Paste a Base64 Data URI or raw Base64, preview supported image data, and download the decoded image.
